requirement_text: The contract is accepted only with evidence from one exact candidate SHA.
Acceptance evidence: informational Teresa question creates zero Cases/Runs.
Acceptance evidence: direct Finance or Assessment work creates its canonical object and zero Case.
Acceptance evidence: durable Teresa request creates exactly one Case and one canonical Run under request replay.
Acceptance evidence: restart between NodeRuns resumes from persisted state.
Acceptance evidence: duplicate dispatch/callback/approval produces one business effect.
Acceptance evidence: stale plan/proposal/target version returns 409 and causes no mutation.
Acceptance evidence: timer and human waits survive a simulated multi-day interval.
Acceptance evidence: late binding shows one module object and one Case link, never a copy.
Acceptance evidence: UI, API and real database readback expose the same state and identifiers.
Acceptance evidence: cross-tenant and revoked-membership tests fail closed.
Acceptance evidence: audit reconstructs conversation -> Case -> plan -> Run -> NodeRun -> command -> proposal/decision -> artifact -> deliverable.
Acceptance evidence: a legacy five-step AgentPlan round-trips to START + five nodes + END without loss of tool inputs or approval settings.
Acceptance evidence: Simple, Expert and List expose identical semantic node/edge IDs and graph digest.
Acceptance evidence: List supports the same semantic edits and validation without drag-and-drop.
Acceptance evidence: an Expert branch survives Simple View without flattening or data loss.
Acceptance evidence: a stale graph save returns 409; a published graph cannot be modified.
Acceptance evidence: layout-only updates preserve semantic digest.
Acceptance evidence: every active palette entry resolves to an executable registry version.
Acceptance evidence: unknown/deprecated/unhealthy capabilities block publish with exact reason.
Acceptance evidence: human and Teresa calls reach the same module command and validation.
Acceptance evidence: direct and orchestrated operations create the same canonical artifact type.
Acceptance evidence: every mutation has successful canonical readback.
Acceptance evidence: MCP/API callback replay produces one NodeRun transition and one effect.
Acceptance evidence: artifact chips deep-link to the canonical owner object and exact revision.
Acceptance evidence: API contract, schema and negative authorization tests pass on one SHA.

Increment 10 (Golden Cases and production candidate) required flows: Golden B (direct Finance without Case -> late binding -> Teresa KPI and recommendation -> approval -> deliverable -> closeout); Golden A (mandate -> Interview -> Assessment/DRD -> Finance/KPI -> Recommendation -> Decision -> Initiative -> Execution -> Results -> Benefits -> Sustainability -> DOCX/PPTX). DoD/evidence: one exact deployed SHA and one canonical database; fresh migration replay plus idempotent rerun; API, browser, realDB, restart/replay and artifact evidence match the SHA; cross-tenant/project and revoked-membership suites pass; operator trace reconstructs the full causal chain; every gate is literally PASS, PARTIAL, BLOCKED, FAILED, EVIDENCE_MISSING or N/A_WITH_CODEX_APPROVAL (N/A valid only for literal canon out-of-scope or an immutable exact Codex approval reference).
Golden Case A purpose: prove the system remains light. Flow: CFO intake -> financial source selection -> margin analysis -> sensitivity -> Findings -> Recommendation -> CFO review.
Golden Case A must prove: Small/Lightweight Case path with no process theatre.
Golden Case A must prove: direct Finance capability and canonical Finance artifact.
Golden Case A must prove: reproducible calculations and source provenance.
Golden Case A must prove: assumptions and contradictory evidence visible.
Golden Case A must prove: decision-ready result without mandatory Initiative.
Golden Case A must prove: valid closure after the contracted diagnosis is accepted.
Golden Case A failure shield: no invented baseline or ROI.
Golden Case A failure shield: no Case expansion merely because Teresa participated.
Golden Case A failure shield: no document treated as proof of calculation.

Golden Case B purpose: prove TRANSFORMATION profile with CONTROLLED governance and complete consulting lineage. Flow: contract -> discovery/interviews -> assessments -> financial baseline -> options -> challenger -> Decision -> Initiatives -> execution -> KPI/benefits -> sustainability.
Golden Case B must prove: multiple roles, modules and memberships.
Golden Case B must prove: progressive planning and material replan.
Golden Case B must prove: conflict-aware evidence.
Golden Case B must prove: proportionate independent challenger.
Golden Case B must prove: human Decision and exact approval version.
Golden Case B must prove: Initiative ownership and execution readback.
Golden Case B must prove: KPI/ROI source lineage and attribution.
Golden Case B must prove: consistent DOCX/PPTX/XLS from one accepted facts digest.
Golden Case B must prove: Monitoring Case split when the sustainability window exceeds delivery closure.
Golden Case B failure shield: no self-approved recommendation.
Golden Case B failure shield: no target presented as actual.
Golden Case B failure shield: no final outcome claim before the measurement window.
Golden Case C flow: standalone Assessment -> Teresa gap synthesis -> LIGHT Case -> material investment Decision -> STANDARD or TRANSFORMATION Case with CONTROLLED governance.
Golden Case C must prove: initial Assessment works without Case.
Golden Case C must prove: canonical artifact is referenced or pinned to an exact revision, not copied.
Golden Case C must prove: promotion preserves owner, version and lineage.
Golden Case C must prove: governance tier increases before the material action.
Golden Case C must prove: earlier approvals do not authorize the expanded scope.
Golden Case D flow: Interview -> evidence -> option analysis -> challenger -> Decision: no action.
Golden Case D must prove: Case may complete successfully without Initiative.
Golden Case D must prove: rationale, alternatives and evidence remain durable.
Golden Case D must prove: no fictitious ROI or execution result is created.
Golden Case D must prove: acceptance reflects DECISION_COMPLETED, not FAILED.
Golden Case E flow: partial step persistence -> process failure -> restart -> idempotent resume -> expired approval -> reapproval -> completion.
Golden Case E must prove: realDB state survives restart.
Golden Case E must prove: no duplicate event or artifact mutation.
Golden Case E must prove: expired approval blocks execution.
Golden Case E must prove: retry history and correlation IDs are complete.
Golden Case E must prove: operator and user see the same recovery state.
Golden Case E must prove: compensation/rollback record exists where relevant.
Golden Case F flow: user creates private Play draft -> validates -> test Case -> requests shared publication -> reviewer changes/rejects/approves -> immutable published version -> Case instantiation.
Golden Case F must prove: every authorized user can author privately.
Golden Case F must prove: draft is absent from shared search/catalog.
Golden Case F must prove: review evaluates governance, data, waits, failures and evidence.
Golden Case F must prove: publication is versioned and audited.
Golden Case F must prove: rejected/requested changes do not leak a shared version.
Golden Case F must prove: instance edits do not mutate the Play.
Golden Cases A–F pass without mocks substituting named runtime layers.
